entities.summary: John Baptist Kakubi was a Ugandan Roman Catholic prelate. He served as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Mbarara, in Uganda from 1969 until his resignation in 1991. He died on 11 February 2016 as the Bishop Emeritus of Mbarara, Uganda. He was 86 years old.
